text:
Maya R.: Deploy to prod finished for release/optimize-caching. Who can run post-deploy smoke checks? I'm in a 10m meeting — please watch metrics (latency, error rate) and run the quick sanity commands. Rollback plan: INF-542 is primed.

Josh K.: I'm on it, running the smoke suite now. Will post results.

Josh K.: Smoke script output:
```
$ ./ci/smoke.sh --env prod --services api,embeddings
api: 200 OK
chat: 200 OK
embeddings: 200 OK
```
But embeddings 95p latency looks high in Grafana: ~420ms vs baseline ~230ms :warning:

Li W.: Noted. Checking model-pod logs and queue depth. I see GC spikes and one pod with elevated CPU.

Sara P.: Bumping embeddings pool by +1 replica from console now. I'll also tail the prefix-cache misses.

DeployBot: Canary check complete. All health checks OK. Alerts: embeddings_95p_latency > threshold.

Josh K.: Running a quick curl to the embeddings endpoint for a few samples:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/embeddings -d '{"text":"test"}' | jq '.latency'
> 0.42
```

Li W.: Restarted the noisy pod, saw immediate drop in CPU but latency stays elevated. Cache miss rate increased 2x — looks like prefix cache didn't warm up after rollout.

Sara P.: Cache warmup script kicked in, miss rate decreasing; 3/5m moving avg trending back to baseline. No error spikes.

Maya R.: OK — plan: monitor 30m. If embeddings_95p doesn't fall below 300ms, we'll rollback to v1.14. Josh, be ready to run:
```
./deploy rollback --service embeddings --version v1.14 --force
```

Josh K.: Ready, will revert if we hit threshold. For now continuing to watch traces for any long tails.

Li W.: Adding temporary autoscale rule to keep at least 2 replicas until next release. Also filing INF-548 for cache-warmup improvement.

Maya R.: Thanks all. If metrics look stable in 30m I'll mark the release green and update the release notes. :raised_hands: :white_check_mark:
